args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks – rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 to production, the service failed health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 18%. The v2.3.1-rc build had also been unhealthy in staging. The SRE agent rolled checkout-api back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback all regions run v2.3.0, the service is healthy, and the error rate is 0.2%. Next steps: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before trying to deploy it again.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. The SEV2 incident is open as INC-0001.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an 18% error rate. v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production, so I rolled back to it. Afterward, all three regions are on v2.3.0 and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** The request to open the incident timed out. Before trying again, I checked the incident list and found it had been created. I didn't retry, so the on-call engineer was paged only once. The incident covers the failed release, the rollback, the current healthy state, and a next step: find the root cause before v2.3.1 is deployed again.

The release candidate, v2.3.1-rc, was also unhealthy in staging, so the problem could have been caught before it reached production.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
